name: runner-gate-test
description: Fixtures for the runner-dispatch gate tests

no-console.reason: The census of 2026-11-25 found no console call in the source and the tests. A new call fails at once, and each call fails from 2027-01-20.

typed-scripts.reason: The two scripts are JavaScript with JSDoc types. tsc reads those types for the tests that import gate-lib.mjs, but it does not check the scripts: with checkJs, the strict preset finds 106 errors. It ends when the scripts become TypeScript files.

shared-ci.reason: Each workflow of this repository must pass the guard of test/guard.ts, and a shared workflow can bring other triggers, permissions and secrets (README, The guard). Thus ci.yml keeps its own steps.

pages-site.reason: This repository holds only the fixtures of the gate tests of runner-dispatch, so it has no site. The Pages workflow of the template is a shared workflow, and the guard of test/guard.ts refuses a call of a shared workflow. The exception holds while the guard has that rule.
